catalyst_rows.raw_text: Research and development expenses increased ... primarily due to increased expenses for manufacturing-related activities and other preparations for the planned Phase 2 clinical study of EB06 in vitiligo patients ... Manufacturing plans for our upcoming vitiligo study are on schedule, and we are advancing the EB06 program toward regulatory readiness and launch.

extractor_notes.blockers: Edesa PRs reference upcoming EB06 vitiligo Phase 2 manufacturing readiness but provide no specific calendar date; conservatively year-precision tag applied.
